name: Adding a battery to a solar PV plant in Greece: the rules of article 11Γ of Law 4685/2020
description: Which PV plants can add a battery, minimum capacity, payment, injection limits, permit amendments, the order of examination at ΑΔΜΗΕ and ΔΕΔΔΗΕ, the letter of guarantee and fire safety, with the provision for each.
creator: Ariadne Labs

rows.Rule: plants commissioned after 4 July 2019, new plants with a Final Connection Offer that were not operating on 1 December 2025, and new plants that will receive one, provided they hold a sale contract or an operating support contract; also self-consumption PV and PV selling in the market without support
usable capacity of at least one hour at the PV plant's installed power
to the Licensing Body for RES and High-Efficiency CHP or to the competent operator, as the case may be
the sale or support contract stays in force for the energy from the PV units; energy from the battery is paid at day-ahead and other market prices, measured by a separate certified meter

rows.What: Limit when charging from the PV only (par. 11A)
rows.Rule: a permanent cap of 40% of installed power from 07:00 to 19:00, no permanent cap from 19:00 to 07:00
rows.Provision: art. 11Γ par. 5.α(a), as amended by Law 5299/2026

rows.What: Limit when also charging from the grid (par. 11B)
rows.Rule: the hourly injection limits for storage stations on the transmission system, until more specific limits are set
the Producer Certificate, the Final Connection Offer, the environmental permits and any other permit are amended with priority

rows.What: ΔΕΔΔΗΕ: requests after 30 November 2025 that take new grid capacity
rows.Rule: examined only after the 900 MW for standalone storage on the distribution network is used up, except the "Storage Systems in Businesses" programme
rows.Provision: art. 11Γ par. 4, as amended by Law 5299/2026

rows.Rule: a joint request for a storage station sized up to the PV plants' combined installed power; on the transmission system, absolute priority up to 1,000 MW until the merchant battery ranking decision
rows.Provision: art. 11Γ par. 5 and 5.δ, as amended by Law 5325/2026

rows.Rule: required for every application; based on maximum generation power (par. 11A) or maximum injection power (par. 11B)
rows.Provision: art. 11Γ par. 5.γ, as amended by Law 5299/2026; art. 6, Law 4951/2022

rows.Rule: the measures of sections Στ.1 and Στ.2 of Annex Β of ΥΠΕΝ/ΔΙΠΑ/103448/7298/2024
